timeline.body: it is better to print the “failScheduleOffset” value at last.

reply.body: When offset > cqMaxOffset  failScheduleOffset = cqMaxOffset, when offset < cqMinOffset  failScheduleOffset = cqMinOffset. In general, failscheduleoffset = offset. So all relevant offset values have been printed in the current log. There is no need to print failScheduleOffset at last.
